item.title: MPA 2479: Applied AI for Public Policy
item.description: A course in the Master of Public Affairs program at the Watson Institute, Brown University. Fall 2026, Thursdays 9:00 to 11:30 am. Students do a piece of policy analysis from start to finish with an AI coding agent alongside them, following the eight steps in Bardach and Patashnik’s A Practical Guide for Policy Analysis, and then treat the regulation of AI as a policy question of its own.

item.title: AI-Assisted Coding for Social Data Analysis
item.description: A five-day short course, co-taught with Bing Tian, on using AI coding agents to do real research on your own data: running analyses, coding your data, checking every result, collecting data, reading literature, and building a small website or app.
